parts.name: ADC v1.1 complete native assembled shell

notes: All 3710 triangles of the complete assembled native shell retained with one common rigid half turn about Y and translation, scale 1. Components 1/2 are displaced copies, 2026 + 1684 triangles. No hole fills, cuts, scales or separate shell registration. PCB, fixed terminals, metal contacts, Grove internals and removable plug reconstructed separately from exact U013-V11 official photographs and schematic; concealed positions are inferred.
